verdicts.reason: A: headline, body and CTA share one left edge, but the 'NOW OPEN' eyebrow now sits after the CTA, which breaks the reading order, and the button touches it with no gap. The logo floats on the busy photo strip and its tiny tagline is unreadable. B has the same eyebrow-after-CTA problem plus worse faults: the MONOGRAPH wordmark straddles the white panel edge (a collision), the body copy is indented from the headline (ragged alignment), and 'NOW OPEN' floats loose to the right of the button.
